accessibility_and_testing.rules: All interactive buttons, links, form fields, and modal toggles must have explicit data-testid and aria labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a JS/React frontend incorporating Framer Motion, Lenis smooth scrolling, Three.js/R3F interactive hero 3D canvas, and Tailwind CSS.
Implement the masked line-by-line kinetic headline reveal on hero load.
Use Lenis for momentum smooth scrolling.
Do NOT use any personal headshots or face photos — showcase technical work, project architecture, interactive demos, and metrics.
Render an SVG logo mark for Ritesh Kapoor in header and footer, also set favicon dynamically or in index.html.
Ensure all data-testid attributes match the specified list for test automation.
